rows.grounds: genitive plural referring to the ten winds named in the preceding context
genitive plural modifying the ten winds
optative third person plural of as
nominative plural adjective agreeing with aṃśāḥ

items.question: What are the portions of the ten winds said to be?
premises: the ten winds are named in the preceding context
their portions are the subject of the statement
those portions are described as endless
items.inference: the ten winds possess portions that are endless
uncertainties: anantakāḥ may mean endless rather than numerically infinite
items.plain_english: The portions of these ten winds would be endless.
